title: ShippingCarrier - Data API
description: Shipping company or carrier responsible for transporting goods or packages. Examples include UPS, FedEx, and USPS. This object is available in API version 61.0 and later.

ExternalReference.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
ExternalReference.description: Unique code, reference, or identifier for the shipping carrier associated with the delivery. Can be used for internal tracking or integration purposes.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the record was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date the record was last viewed.

ManagedShippingCarrier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ManagedShippingCarrier.description: Salesforce-managed shipping carrier information that provides estimated transit times. This field is available in API version 65.0 and later. Possible values are: FEDEX UPS USPS

Name.description: Name of the shipping carrier associated with the delivery.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the user who currently owns this ShippingCarrier object. Default value is the user logged in to the API to perform the create. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

special_access_rules: The ShippingCarrier object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.
